falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 4.0% above the verdict-day close within 14 calendar days, and VIX closes below 16.0 on that same session.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: UNKNOWN/HOLD is wrong: price and vol resolved into a confirmed risk-on regime, so the correct signal was long, not flat, and the bottom_2024_aug analog had already completed.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5.0% below the verdict-day close within 14 calendar days, or US high-yield OAS widens by 50 basis points or more versus the verdict-day level.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: HOLD and the 77% bottom_2024_aug match are invalidated: a fresh equity or credit drawdown of this size means the analog bottom failed and the correct signal was risk-off.

falsification_conditions.condition: US 10-year yield closes at least 35 basis points away from the verdict-day yield (either direction) within 14 calendar days, and DXY closes at least 1.5% away from the verdict-day close in that same window.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rates-and-dollar regime break occurred. UNKNOWN/HOLD is falsified because a repricing of this size is an observable macro regime that required a directional signal, not an unresolved flat call. Blowoff score 39 is also stale if that move is a late-cycle rates shock rather than a contained bottom.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
